subject.title: feat(anthropic): complete Claude Opus 5 runtime support

question: Should direct API-key requests for Claude Opus 5 and Fable 5 automatically opt into Anthropic's category-selected fallback policy, including a fallback-served response that may use a different model and rate?
rationale: The implementation follows the current upstream beta shape, but choosing automatic fallback changes OpenClaw's provider-routing and cost-policy contract for users who selected a specific model.

options.title: Confirm automatic fallback policy
options.body: Accept Anthropic's default per-category routing for direct API-key requests after a redacted live request proves the final request, serving model, and cost behavior.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in behavior
options.body: Retain the existing explicit fallback policy until OpenClaw exposes a deliberate user-facing control or documents the changed model-selection guarantee.

options.title: Defer fallback expansion
options.body: Merge only the independent Opus 5 capabilities and hold the automatic fallback and related pricing changes for a narrower policy-reviewed PR.

recommendation.title: Confirm automatic fallback policy
recommendation.body: Accept Anthropic's default per-category routing for direct API-key requests after a redacted live request proves the final request, serving model, and cost behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This member is assigned to the PR and authored the focused Anthropic runtime changes that introduce the policy choice.
